deepdive.sec: Real Estate Development & Distressed Asset Resolution

bull_bear.body: Priority 1: Fund real estate construction (internal accruals + cash reserves). Priority 2: Scale broking tech/platform. Priority 3: Run-off NBFC book to generate cash. No dividends mentioned; focus on reinvestment for growth. Net cash position (INR 750 Cr) provides buffer.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Execution risk on delivering 3x profit growth by FY28. Real estate cycle downturn affecting sales velocity. Delay in Worli tower leasing/commissioning. Regulatory changes in broking/ARC sectors. Concentration risk in NCR/Mumbai markets.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Highly confident, transparent on past failures (fintech exit), and focused on 'execution' over 'vision'. Emphasized clean balance sheet, zero litigation, and predictable earnings visibility from signed pipelines.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: The INR 3,000 Cr tax shield inherited from the merger creates a unique scenario where PBT equals PAT for the foreseeable future, artificially inflating net margins compared to peers. The NBFC book is being run off without debt, turning a traditional leveraged business into a pure cash-flow generator.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Stated policy is growth without leverage: zero net debt, with owned land parcels and JVs carrying no borrowings.
- ₹1,000.07 Cr preferential capital raise approved to fund GDV expansion entirely through equity rather than debt.
- Promoters are committing ₹709 Cr, roughly 71% of the raise, which will lift promoter holding from the current 33%.
- Shareholding stands at 33% promoters, 17.19% FII and DII, and 50% public and others; capital is deployed based on GDV and business-expansion opportunities.
- IARCL is substantially unlevered with 99.52% capital adequacy against the 15% RBI regulatory minimum and ₹520.15 Cr net worth.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body: Real Estate (80% of future profit): Revenue recognition on percentage completion. Key assets include Indiabulls Tower Prabhadevi (leased, est. INR 100-120 Cr/year annuity). Financial Services: Broking (INR 28 Cr PBT FY26, shifting to online/algo); ARC (AUM INR 622 Cr fee-paying, INR 3,794 Cr allocated, profits expected from FY27); NBFC (Run-off mode, INR 1,000 Cr book, zero debt, ~1% NPA).
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
| Challenge | Beneficiary/Loser | Dir | Conviction | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Competitors in broking (Zerodha, Groww) face a revived incumbent with deep capital and 25-year brand trust re-entering the discount/algo space. | Discount Brokers | loser | Med | Indiabulls claims new tech stack and team to capture share; market is large but competition is fierce. |
| Real estate peers with high debt loads face higher financing costs compared to Indiabulls' net-cash status. | Indiabulls Limited | beneficiary | High | Net cash + tax shield provides superior margin profile and execution speed vs leveraged peers. |
| Banks/NBFCs selling stressed assets gain a capable resolver with strong recovery infrastructure. | Indian Banks | beneficiary | Low | Indiabulls ARC scaling up AUM, providing liquidity to banking system. |
business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- Presented as a clean, single listed entity spanning real estate and financial services with no cross-holdings and no leverage.
- Real-estate portfolio is deliberately concentrated in what the deck calls India's deepest luxury micro-markets, with 87% of GDV in NCR, 11% Mumbai and 2% Ludhiana.
- The ARC platform is framed as a licensed, niche business with high entry barriers that limit competition and enable differentiated execution.
- Broking arm claims TTM revenue of ₹131 Cr (+4%) despite an industry-wide slowdown, attributing growth to compounding digital client acquisition.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [ESG] Indiabulls Tower has achieved IGBC Pre-certified Gold certification.
- [Corporate identity] The company was formerly named Yaari Digital Integrated Services Limited; the rebrand to Indiabulls Limited is reflected throughout the deck and filings.
- [Recognition] Awards cited include a CII Special Appreciation Award, TransUnion CIBIL Best Data Quality Award to the ARC, and Bharat NBFC & Fintech Awards 2026 Best Retail Web Trading Platform.
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body: Real estate margins protected by 15% price appreciation post-launch and strict payment discipline (80% collection rate on sold units). Cost base streamlined via merger; no debt interest burden. Tax efficiency is a major margin driver (effective tax rate ~0% near term).
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: Revenue Growth: Real estate profits expected to double in FY27 and triple in FY28 vs FY26 base; Margin: PBT = PAT until INR 3,000 Cr cumulative profit due to tax shield; Order Inflow: 40 Lakh sq ft launching in FY27 (GDV INR 6,000+ Cr); Capex/Commissioning: INR 600 Cr capex for Worli commercial tower, completion in 3-4 years.
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: Total GDV potential INR 21,000+ Cr across 1.1 Cr sq ft. Includes launched projects (75-100% sold: Estate Sector 104, Heights Sector 104), upcoming FY27 launches (40 Lakh sq ft, GDV INR 6,000+ Cr), and future pipeline (42 Lakh sq ft, GDV INR 11,900+ Cr). Mix of residential, commercial, and plotted developments in Gurugram, Mumbai, Ludhiana.
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: 1) Commercial leasing annuity from Worli/Prabhadevi tower starting Year 4. 2) Re-rating of broking business with new online/algo stack capturing market share from incumbents. 3) Mark-to-market gains on US investment (SpringCash) as it scales disbursals. 4) Potential revival of NBFC lending post run-off (currently paused).
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Indiabulls has completed a 3-year restructuring to emerge as a net-cash entity with a clean balance sheet, pivoting aggressively back to its core real estate competency where a INR 21,000 Cr GDV pipeline promises a 3x PAT expansion by FY28. The removal of legacy litigations and loss-making fintech ventures unlocks significant value, supported by a unique tax shield that equates PBT to PAT for the next INR 3,000 Cr of profits.

open.item: A future pipeline of 42 lakh square feet valued at over Rs 11,900 crores sits beyond the current year launches.
open.promised: 42 lakh sq ft / Rs 11,900+ cr INR cr

open.item: UPI and PPI licenses are expected to come in this quarter, to serve as a nodal connection across the online businesses rather than as a profit driver.
Real estate profits in FY27 are expected to grow at least 2x versus FY26 levels.

Broking is a stated focus area with a new online discount broking team, many product launches planned this year and ambitious growth plans, after adding 28,000 customers in Q4FY26 and earning about Rs 28 crores of broking PBT in FY26.
open.promised: visible growth within one year; Rs 28 cr FY26 PBT base INR cr

open.item: The roughly Rs 1,000 crore legacy loan book should generate about Rs 120 crores of topline over the full year, with no debt against it.
The asset reconstruction business, in its first year of collections, is expected to start delivering profits from next year (FY27).
Approximately 40 lakh square feet of projects with GDV of over Rs 6,000 crores are planned for launch in the current financial year (FY27).
open.promised: 40 lakh sq ft / Rs 6,000+ cr GDV lakh sq ft / INR cr

open.item: Real estate is expected to contribute nearly 80% of group profit.
The NBFC loan book will be reduced slowly with no plans to disburse fresh loans this year or next year; shareholders will be informed if that changes.
Real estate profits in FY28 are expected to be at least 3x the current level.

The Indiabulls Tower Prabhadevi leased commercial asset (2.5 lakh sellable sq ft) is expected to generate stable annuity rent of Rs 100-120 crores per year, starting from the fourth year onwards; management confirmed there is no plan to sell it.
open.promised: Rs 100-120 cr per year (corrected from Rs 1,000 cr in call) INR cr per year

open.item: Capital expenditure to develop the Prabhadevi/Worli commercial asset will be roughly Rs 600 crores.
Construction of the Indiabulls Tower commercial asset at Prabhadevi/Worli has started and the project is expected to be ready in the next three to four years.
Management expects roughly seven years to convert the entire GDV into the balance sheet, completing all current construction projects by FY31 and at the latest FY32-33.
Total GDV potential of approximately Rs 21,000+ crores across a sellable area exceeding 1.1 crore square feet spanning Gurugram, Mumbai and Ludhiana.
open.promised: Rs 21,000+ cr GDV / 1.1 crore sq ft INR cr

open.item: Management expects to cross Rs 1,000-1,500 crores of PAT in the coming five to seven years.
Real estate collections run at roughly 80% recovery on all sold units and the same cancellation-backed payment discipline will continue.

open.horizon: until Rs 3,000 cr of PBT is cumulated
open.item: The merger left an inherited tax shield of roughly Rs 3,000 crores, so PBT and PAT will remain the same until that shield is exhausted.
open.promised: Rs 3,000 cr tax shield; PBT = PAT INR cr

open.item: Management asserted there are no litigations or financial liabilities at Indiabulls Limited or its 17 subsidiaries and that all ECL/non-recoverable loans were provided for as of 31 March 2026, with gross NPA around 1% and confidence of recovering most outstandings.

wtt.summary: Building track record — 1Q logged, no reconciled verdicts yet.
wtt.tone_latest: Highly confident and promotional (multi-year 2x/3x profit and Rs 1,000-1,500 cr PAT aspirations); management owned past missteps in fintech lending and three lost restructuring years in broking, but overstated Worli rental by ~10x on the call and had to correct it to Rs 100-120 cr via written annotations.

meta.thesis: Indiabulls has completed a 3-year restructuring to emerge as a net-cash entity with a clean balance sheet, pivoting aggressively back to its core real estate competency where a INR 21,000 Cr GDV pipeline promises a 3x PAT expansion by FY28. The removal of legacy litigations and loss-making fintech ventures unlocks significant value, supported by a unique tax shield that equates PBT to PAT for the next INR 3,000 Cr of profits.
